units.source_text: 小憩一小时之后，汉子带我到了另一家温泉旅馆。

en.t: After resting for about an hour, the man took me to another hot spring inn.

units.source_text: 这以前，我只想着要同艺人们同住一家小客店。

en.t: Until then, I had only been thinking that I wanted to stay at the same small inn as the performers.

units.source_text: 我们从大街往下走过百来米的碎石路和石台阶，过了小河边公共浴场旁的一座桥。

en.t: From the main street, we went downhill along about a hundred meters of gravel path and stone steps, then crossed a bridge beside the public bath by the stream.

units.source_text: 桥那边就是温泉旅馆的庭院。

en.t: On the other side of the bridge was the courtyard of the hot spring inn.
